title: Strong Continuity Without Ultraviolet Regularization
exact_target: Determine whether the source many-body time evolution remains strongly continuous after its ultraviolet cutoff is removed.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006190 (OWR-14299085-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mini-Workshop: New Directions in Correlated Quantum Systems (2025), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2025/7, pp. 339--374. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: Strong continuity at fixed cutoff does not automatically pass to a cutoff limit; the source representation and limiting dynamics must be identified.
